- Due: HbA1c not indicated; next review in 3 months.

memories.text: Hand X‑ray (PA): Soft tissue swelling noted; no erosions seen. Joint spaces preserved. Impression: Early inflammatory change, consistent with rheumatoid arthritis; no bony damage yet.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Rheumatology, Bangalore Baptist Hospital. Reason: Establish baseline disease activity, consider adding steroid‑sparing agent. Attach recent labs and X‑ray.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Rheumatology review: Patient has active RA with seropositivity. Recommend continuing methotrexate 10 mg weekly, adding sulfasalazine 500 mg BD, tapering prednisolone to 2.5 mg OD over 4 weeks. Repeat ESR/CRP in 6 weeks.

- Generalised anxiety disorder: Patient reports good control, occasional mild worry. GAD-7 score 6 (mild). Status: stable. Plan: Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD.
- Rheumatoid arthritis: On methotrexate + sulfasalazine, prednisolone tapered to 2.5 mg OD. No joint swelling, morning stiffness 15 mins. Status: improved. Plan: Continue current regimen, monitor LFT.
- Weight 57.5 kg, waist 69 cm.
- Due: Next review in 3 months; repeat labs then.
